journal_validation.notes: 9 shapes (CREATE node, CREATE edge between literal endpoints, MERGE ON CREATE, SET+label+REMOVE, DELETE edge, DETACH DELETE, FOREACH literal list, a query failing with -119, a read) plus a caller transaction. Every row/index/^KG/^NKG write of one query is inside one outermost transaction (nested Txn_Begin levels); the failed query's net effect is empty (BitSET-aware); the read journals no write; with a caller transaction open, the failure leaves $TLEVEL 1 and the caller's row, and the caller's ROLLBACK removes everything. Declared-but-not-observed stores are may-writes not exercised (DETACH DELETE of an edgeless node; ^NKG only when built).

entry_points.transaction: one IVG level per write query: write_txn -> Graph_KG.Txn_Begin (TSTART, nested under a caller transaction), Txn_End (TCOMMIT to the caller's level), Txn_Undo (TROLLBACK 1) on any exception or an error answer (query.py:1946-1966; _write_txn.py; Txn.cls:19-58); execute_transaction opens a nested level per statement set (iris_sql_store.py:1580-1583, 1780-1790). Reads: no transaction (autocommit), default isolation (read uncommitted).
